advice: Abstain. No legal, useful cache-conflict layout change is established by the supplied evidence. The 272-byte packed-A stride was already measured in both battery modes and was not promoted; its noisy scores do not show a cache-set cause. The supplied CPU profile gives cache sizes and line size, but not cache associativity, set mapping, or measured conflict behavior. A new stride or layout would therefore be an unsupported guess.
risks: Do not repeat the measured 272-byte layout. Any future padding proposal must give the exact stride, allocation size, consumer offsets, and rewinds, prove every packed access stays in bounds, and include the full timed packing/allocation cost. No speedup or cache-conflict mechanism is established here.
